references.text: People in Jerusalem ask the same question about Jesus' identity and where he is, while discussing whether he is the one they are looking for.
The Pharisees send servants to arrest Jesus, showing the same intensity in their search for him as expressed in verse 11.
The chief priests and Pharisees gather to discuss what they should do about Jesus, fearing that everyone will believe in him, which reflects their search for him in verse 11.
Jesus meets them with the words "I am he" when asked who they are looking for, directly answering the question "Where is he?" in verse 11.
